name: the-crawler
title: TheCrawler — validated web extraction contracts for AI agents
description: Crawl public pages, diagnose whether a public source is ready for contract extraction, and extract typed JSON with validation evidence. Built-in contracts currently cover real-estate-listing, product-page, and docs-page workflows; diagnostics check required signals, report blockers before spending LLM tokens, and can write a buyer-readable readiness report. Also supports brand-identity extraction (ranked color palette, theme-color, logo candidates; reads rendered colors via Playwright), content controls (only-main-content, include/exclude CSS tags, waitFor), html and rawHtml formats, plain crawl output, markdown, heading-aware chunks, JSON-LD, microdata, commerce data, forms, analytics tracker detection, hreflang, redirects, structured errors, retryability, adaptive Cheerio-to-Playwright crawling, PDF, and DOCX when reachable. Open source engine (AGPL-3.0). $500 extraction readiness sprint / fit check before payment: https://www.miaibot.ai/tools/thecrawler/readiness-sprint
